Payments built for speed

1. Select Pay by Bank

Customers choose Pay by Bank with Trustly in your checkout.

2. Pre-populate bank details

Bank details are pre-filled for customers who’ve saved their details with Trustly before.

3. Bank app or eID consent

They authenticate in their bank app or eID with a single SCA, reducing fraud without leaving your checkout.

4. Payment confirmation

They finish up on your confirmation page—completing their payment 2x faster than usual.

Bank-grade security for every transaction

Data protection

We use top-tier encryption, comply with GDPR, and are TÜV Saarland accredited—offering strong protection for both partners and consumers.

Compliance

We meet KYC, AML and CTF regulations, hold ISO 27001 certification, and operate under the supervision of the Swedish and British supervisory authorities.

Incident management

We have a robust incident management process with 24/7 support, an RTO of four hours, and a tested business continuity and disaster recovery plan.

Testing and audits

We undergo annual penetration testing and third-party audits (SOC 2, ISO 27001) to ensure top-level security and compliance.

Learn more about security

Get started quickly

There are two ways to start offering Trustly in your checkout, designed to match your goals and business.

Visit the dev portal

Direct integration

Access our full product suite in 33+ markets with one integration to our JSON-RPC-based API—giving you full customisation, control and dedicated support, as well as access to our sandbox and dev docs.

Plug-and-play with PSPs

Get a faster start with near-instant access when you activate Trustly with all major payment service providers (PSPs) and checkout solutions. You also have access to Trustly experts to guide you.

Trustly Group AB (corporate identity number 556754-8655) is an authorized Swedish payment institution under the supervision of the Swedish Financial Supervisory Authority (Finansinspektionen). Trustly Group AB conducts payment services in accordance with the Swedish Payment Services Act (2010:751) and Directive (EU) 2015/2366 on payment services (PSD2) and can provide cross-border payment services within the EU/EEA. Trustly UK Limited is an Authorised Payment Institution and is regulated by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) under the Payment Services Regulations 2017 (Firm Reference Number: 1005703). Ecospend Technologies Limited is an Authorised Payment Institution and is regulated by the FCA under the Payment Services Regulations 2017 (Firm Reference Number: 829713). SlimPay SA is a payment institution registered in Paris under number 518991336 under the supervision of the Autorité de contrôle prudentiel et de résolution (ACPR)
